claim: The entire public 0.940-0.947 band is one identical codebase driven by BIOHUB_* environment variables; the whole +0.007 climb from 0.940 to 0.947 comes from three extra flags (post-process sweep validator, DeepCenter TTA, secondary edge-feature TTA), not from any modelling change.
source: sjlee101/biohub-lf-dctta cell 6 vs nusrati/0-940 cell 6 (env-var preset blocks)

claim: A second learned model, a 'DeepCenter' center-prior UNet3D from a separate dataset, is used purely as a VETO on gap-closes and on safe-division insertion in every 0.940+ notebook; it is a precision gate, not a detector.
The 0.940+ family does attempt divisions, but only through a heavily capped 'safe division' post-link insertion: at most 0.76% of a frame's nodes and 0.375% globally may become new division sources.

kaiwalyaatulraut/biohub-solution is the only high-scoring notebook with a fully independent detector: its own 2-model UNet3D ensemble (base=24) from a private weights dataset, differing preprocessing per model, with no support pack, no ILP and no learned edge scorer - association is pure constant-velocity Hungarian.
quote:
